title: Provider-neutral Forge seam with a GitHub adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral `Forge` trait (branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, head commit, capabilities) plus a pure `report_change` step that runs those calls in one fixed order, an in-memory `FakeForge` double, and a `GitHub` adapter that drives the existing `gh` command line. The `osf` CLI's review-post, status-apply and status-refresh paths are rewired to go through the trait instead of calling `gh` directly, and `pr_status` loses its process-spawning code in favour of a pure `parse_checks`/`gates_from_checks` split.

nodes.label: osf main
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/main.rs
nodes.summary: Subcommand handlers now build a `github::GitHub<RealGh>` adapter and call the `Forge` trait for head commit, review post, status block write and check-status reads.

nodes.label: review post / --post-to
nodes.summary: Builds a `forge::NewReview` from the review plan and posts it through the trait; reports `PostedReview` (advisory flag) instead of `review::Outcome`.

nodes.label: pr status apply
nodes.summary: Dry run still reads the body directly; the real write now goes through `Forge::write_status_block`.

nodes.label: pr status refresh
nodes.summary: Gates now come from `Forge::read_check_status` (or a checks JSON file) and the final write goes through `Forge::write_status_block`.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: create_branch, open_pull_request, write_status_block, post_review, read_check_status, head_commit, capabilities
nodes.summary: The provider-neutral seam. Object-safe, `Send + Sync`, and names no provider, URL or command.

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: open → status block → capabilities → review → checks
nodes.summary: The engine's Report step as pure run code: one fixed order, stops at the first failed step, skips the post when a known verdict list omits the draft verdict (a Comment verdict always posts).

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.summary: In-memory `Forge` that records every call as data and can script per-operation answers and failures; no process, file, network or clock work.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: GitHub<C: GhClient>
nodes.summary: Implements `Forge` by driving the `gh` command line through a `GhClient`: API POSTs for branch and pull request, review post with self-review fallback, check-status and capability reads.

nodes.label: RealGh
nodes.summary: The `GhClient` that actually spawns `gh`, moved here from `pr_status`; the only place a process is started for forge work.

nodes.label: GhClient trait
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/pr_status.rs
nodes.summary: Gains a raw `run(args, stdin)` method returning `GhOutput`; the concrete `RealGh` implementation moved out to the GitHub adapter.

nodes.label: pr_status pure helpers
nodes.summary: `gates_from_checks_json` is split into `parse_checks` (JSON → triples) and `gates_from_checks` (triples → gate spec), so the adapter can reuse the parse without shelling out.

nodes.label: review module
nodes.summary: Loses `fetch_head_sha` and `post_via_gh` to the adapter; keeps the pure payload/fallback decision logic and `fetch_diff`, and exposes `parse_head_sha_json`.

nodes.label: gh command line
nodes.summary: The installed GitHub CLI and the GitHub API behind it; every forge operation ultimately lands here.
